mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, an unusually large completed displacement per square-root execution count indicates that limited transaction-processing activity produced disproportionate repricing. Follow the completed direction for eight hours at the fresh elasticity-tail onset.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: CAEVC compares cross-asset standardized execution-count response minus path variation; CAIIC divides return by quote turnover and removes an alt median; ticket candidates divide turnover by counts. HVECE is a BTC-only count-normalized endpoint displacement, uses no cross-asset residual, turnover, ticket, flow, funding, OI, prior event, or control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: both completed realized variation and count-normalized displacement must enter independent causal upper tails
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three daily execution-elasticity onsets are absent from Gross9

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.execution_count: sum integer nonnegative number_of_trades over 480 rows, strict positive
features.completed_return: log(last close/first open), finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sum squared log(close/open) minute returns, finite strict positive
features.elasticity_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent BTC-only endpoint displacement per square-root execution count

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no count normalization, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
